_meta.status: draft — Conrad reviews voice and flips approved=true per template before promotion
voiceGuidelines: Plain English, not corporate. Short sentences.
Conrad signs personally. Phone number for urgent.
No auto-reply on claim/cancel/compliance — those are conversations, not transactions.
Templates use {{var_name}} for substitution. Vars listed in each template's frontmatter.

lead.conradAction: Personal call within 1 business day after the auto-ack lands.
lead.notes: First-touch SLA promise. The 5-minute auto-reply buys Conrad time before his personal call.

quoting.conradAction: Review carrier quote, decide bind/decline, reply to underwriter manually.
quoting.notes: Carrier/wholesaler email. Conrad-only — auto-reply to a carrier looks unprofessional.

onboarding.conradAction: Verify ID cards attached and first billing schedule populated before queuing.
onboarding.notes: Triggered ~1 day after DocuSign-completed + first-payment-confirmed event. Welcome touch — sets expectations + asks for a Google review.

service.conradAction: Process the actual request (id card, endorsement, address change). Reply with completion confirmation by EOD — separate from this auto-ack.
service.notes: Auto-ack only. The fulfillment work is a human task.

claim.conradAction: Call client within 30 minutes. Capture FNOL details. File with carrier same day.
claim.notes: URGENT. Handle by phone, never email-only. Auto-reply on a claim could create the wrong liability impression — never automate this bucket.

renewal.conradAction: Inbound renewal questions: personal reply with quote/coverage detail.
renewal.notes: Outbound renewal reminders are owned by the renewal-reminder workflow — distinct from this. This bucket is *inbound* renewal email; Conrad handles personally.

retention.conradAction: Inbound cancel / non-pay / lapse: call within 1 business day, understand the why.
retention.notes: Outbound win-back is the cancellation-winback workflow. Inbound is a conversation — auto-reply on a cancel intent reads cold.

carrier-ops.conradAction: Read on schedule. Action items (commission statements, rate changes, appointments) go into the work queue.

vendor-ops.conradAction: Triage as ops. Most are FYI-only (release notes, scheduled maintenance, invoices).
vendor-ops.notes: System notifications from EZLynx, DocuSign, Wonder Write, etc.

compliance.conradAction: License renewals, CE deadlines, E&O — Conrad-only with a calendar reminder set.
compliance.notes: Regulatory. Never auto-anything. State DOI / NAIC / WA OIC traffic.

internal.notes: Hirobius / family / personal email. Fallback bucket.

noise.conradAction: Mark as junk or unsubscribe. No reply.
